company_name: Zhejiang Futong Quartz New Material Co.,Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in manufacturing quartz products essential for various semiconductor fabrication processes.
summary: Zhejiang Futong Quartz New Material Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of high-quality quartz products used in semiconductor wafer fabrication processes. Their offerings include quartz boats, furnace tubes, and customized quartz solutions tailored for diffusion, CVD, etching, and cleaning processes.
capabilities: Quartz furnace tubes for CVD applications
Customized quartz products for etching and cleaning processes

regional_presence.China: The company is headquartered in Huzhou City, Zhejiang Province, with a self-built factory equipped for quartz processing.
